spans.s: शेव (I) m. 1. The male organ; 2. a snake; 3. height, elevation; 4. happiness; 5. wealth.
शेव (II) n. 1. The penis; 2. happiness.
सेव m. See सेवन (1).

सेवा f. 1. Service, attendance, servitude, सेवां लाघवकारिणीं कृतधियः स्थाने श्ववृत्तिं विदुः Mud.iii.; 2. devotion, worship, homage; 3. addition to; 4. use, practice, employment; 5. resorting to, frequenting.
शेव-धि m. a valuable treasure, सर्वे कामाः शेवधिर्जीवितं वा स्त्रीणां भर्ता धर्मदाराश्च पुंसाम् M.M.vi.
सेवधि m. The same as शेवधि q.v.
शेवल n. 1. The green mosslike substance that grows on the surface of water; 2. a specics of aquatic plant.
शेवाल n. The same as शेवल q.v.
शेवलिनी f. A river.
सी(से)वन n. 1. Sewing, stitching; 2. a seam, a suture.

सेवन n. 1. Sewing, stitching; 2. a sack; 3. following, practising, using; 4. enjoying, enjoying sexually, यत्करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनाद् द्विजः M.xi.178; 5. service, worship, पात्रीकृतात्मा गुरुसेवनेन स्पष्टाकृतिः पत्ररथेंद्रकेतोः R.xviii.30.

सेव् vt. 1Ā (the initial स् of this root is changed into ष् after परि, नि, or वि) (pp. सेवित; pres. सेवते; desid. सिसेविषति) 1. To serve, to wait upon, to honour, to obey, ऐश्वर्यादनपेतमीश्वरमयं लोकोर्थतः सेवते Mud.i.; 2. to follow, to go after, to pursue; 3. to use, to enjoy, तप्तं वारि विहाय तीरनलिनीं कारंडवः सेवते Vikr.ii.; 4. to attend to, to devote oneself to, to cultivate, to practise, to perform; 5. to enjoy (sexually); 6. to frequent, to dwell in, to inhebit, e.g. अगस्त्यसेवितामाशाम्; 7. to watch over, to guard, to protect.With आ-, 1. to enjoy, दीर्घिकावलोकनगवाक्षगता प्रवातमासेवमाना तिष्ठति Mal.i.; 2. to practise.With उप-, 1. to apply oneself to, to practise; 2. to perform; 3. to enjoy; 4. to serve, वैरिणं नोपसेवेत सहायं चैव वैरिणः M.iv.133.With नि-, 1. to pursue, to attach oneself to; 2. to practise; 3. to employ, विषतां निषेवितमपक्रियया Sis.ix.69; 4. to enjoy, निषेवते श्रांतमना विविक्तम् Sak.v.; 5. to inhabit; 6. to observe; 7. to attend.With परि-, to take.
सेवक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Serving, worshipping; 2. practising; 3. servile, dependent.
सेवक (II) m. 1. A servant, भयं तावत्सेव्यादभिनिविशते सेवकजनम् Mud.v.; 2. a votary; 3. a sack.
सेवक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Serving, worshipping; 2. practising; 3. servile, dependent.
सेवनी f. 1. A needle; 2. a seam; 3. a suture.
सेवा-काकु f. change of voice in service.
सेवा-धर्म m. 1. the functions of service, सेवाधर्मः परमगहनो योगिनामप्यगम्यः Hit.ii.; 2. the duty or rule of service.
सेवा-व्यवहार m. the practice of service.
सेवि n. 1. The jujube; 2. an apple.
सेवित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Followed, pursued; 2. served, attended, worshipped; 3. infested or frequented by, inhabited.
सेवित (II) n. 1. The jujube; 2. an apple.
सेवित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Followed, pursued; 2. served, attended, worshipped; 3. infested or frequented by, inhabited.
सेविन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Following, pursuing, serving; 2. practising, using; 3. dwelling.
सेविन् (II) m. A servant.
सेविन् (I) a. (f. नी) 1. Following, pursuing, serving; 2. practising, using; 3. dwelling.
सेव्य (I) a. (f. व्या) 1. To be served or obeyed, भयं तावत्सेव्यादभिनिविशते सेवकजनम् Mud.v.; 2. to be employed; 3. to be enjoyed; 4. to be taken care of, to be guarded.
सेव्य (II) m. The Aśvattha tree.
सेव्य (III) n. A kind of root.
सेव्य (I) a. (f. व्या) 1. To be served or obeyed, भयं तावत्सेव्यादभिनिविशते सेवकजनम् Mud.v.; 2. to be employed; 3. to be enjoyed; 4. to be taken care of, to be guarded.
सेव्य-सेवक m. du. master and servant.
